input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for i admin sys menu, i admin sys role, i admin sys user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with admin sys role functionality, so that I can accomplish my admin sys role-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with user functionality, so that I can accomplish my user-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use admin role capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
